name: Martian Gain (VST3)
description: A multiband distortion. One to five bands, each running one of sixteen algorithms, each with its own limiter — and each level-matched by measurement, so turning DRIVE up changes what a band sounds like without changing how loud it is. The front panel comes off. Underneath is a patch bay where any band's audio or envelope can drive any other band's knobs, or move the crossovers themselves.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260827.2 · free download · 18-page manual included.
